restoreLayout.label: Reopen where I left off
restoreLayout.description: Remembers the open project and chat, the sidebar sections and their sizes, and the pane layout.

restoreDefaultLayout.label: Restore default layout
restoreDefaultLayout.description: Puts every pane, section and size back to how Damocles first opened.

notify.label: Notify me when a chat needs me
notify.description: Pop-ups show on the desktop when a chat needs you, whether or not the Damocles window is focused. Off, notifications still collect under the bell.

notifySound.label: Play a sound with desktop pop-ups
notifySound.description: A short chime when a pop-up appears: rising when a chat waits on you, a single note when one finishes, falling when one stops.
